analysis: Documentation-only changes in docs/architecture/inference.md. The supplied base excerpt (lines 2366-2597, Flint and Bonsai sections) and head excerpt (lines 1-415, Nemotron Super) fall mostly outside the changed ranges. The visible change is the date on head line 3. Other changed ranges, per the patch excerpt, update GLM5Next video handling: variable-frame-rate MP4/QuickTime tracks are now indexed by frame i / nominalFrameRate rather than refused (head ~810-813, 829). The decoded-frame cap remains maximumDecodedBytes at 512 MiB, the 28,532-token prepared-pixel cap and the media reservation are unchanged, and media stays excluded from prefix lookup and capture (permitsHybridCheckpoint). This is a behavior change (new acceptance of VFR video) described only in docs. Availability impact appears bounded by the existing caps, but the implementing Swift source (GLM5NextProcessor.decodeAsset) was not supplied. Integration should verify that decoding all frames up to the last sampled one remains bounded by the byte cap and a decode-time allowance for adversarial VFR tracks, such as huge sample counts or zero durations (TB-007, T-050 video plaintext handling, ADV-002). Head ranges 876-880 and 1717-1726 were not visible here. The Nemotron Super prefix bank, which is scoped by the authenticated tenant cacheScope, and image hybridPrefixIdentity reuse (head 205-241) are unchanged context; they relate to T-041/SEC-035, and no regression is evident. No findings, because no visible changed line establishes a concrete regression.
